declared: 2026-11-07, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The drafts' lang-item and feature prerequisites were settled against rustc 1.98.0 in obj/parallel/census-batch5/repro first; each outcome follows the stated rule, not that exploration

signature-fn-result-length.rs.reason: a crate-root fn result length names a `pub(super)` type through a public alias; rustc's type-privacy pass never visits an anonymous constant of an item signature

signature-field-length.rs.reason: a tuple struct field length names the private type through the alias

signature-const-argument.rs.reason: a const argument in a fn result type names the private type

signature-discriminant.rs.reason: an enum discriminant is an item-level anonymous constant and names the private type

signature-leaked-value-length.rs.reason: an unnamed const's annotation length and a fn result length evaluate public const fns returning the private type

signature-nested-length.rs.reason: a local annotation inside a signature length is still inside an item-level anonymous constant

signature-const-annotation-length.rs.reason: a pub const item's own annotation length names the private type; only its initializer is a body

body-local-length.rs.reason: opponent: a local annotation length inside a crate-root fn body is a nested body constant and type privacy rejects the private type (no error code)

body-repeat-count.rs.reason: opponent: a repeat count inside a fn body names the private type (no error code)

body-const-argument.rs.reason: opponent: a const argument in a local annotation inside a fn body names the private type (no error code)

signature-private-method-length.rs.reason: opponent: associated function privacy is a typeck rule that still holds in a signature length (E0624)
